scope: Custom Town03 diagnostic with occupancy-aware collision post-processing, explicit forward gear, no traffic, inference every 10 frames, and a 400-frame blocked threshold; not an official leaderboard score
control_fix: The reused CARLA 0.9.10.1 binary remained in neutral under direct automatic VehicleControl; manual_gear_shift=true and gear=1 restored longitudinal motion.
planning_protocol: Every PyTorch and TensorRT response applies the same occupancy-aware collision optimizer to raw outs_planning before control.

tensorrt_int8_eq_fp16.calibration: 315 unique validation frames with track input count 901 and independent calibration feeds

latency_definition: Steady state excludes the first inference. Forward is synchronized model/engine execution; service end-to-end includes request NPZ loading, image preprocessing, recurrent state, output transfer, post-processing, and response serialization.
interpretation: Explicit gear fixed the prior neutral-vehicle defect, but all four backends still stall after early contact. The shared blocked failure remains a sensor/domain/controller integration problem rather than an INT8-only runtime failure.
